pillars.title: How OpenLease is different
pillars.subtitle: Car leasing in Australia was built for permanent residents on fixed terms. We built OpenLease for you.

openTerms.title: Open terms
openTerms.body: Your lease matches your timeline — your visa, your contract, your project. 9 to 36 months, any month in between. Most leases force you into 12 or 24. Yours can be exactly 15.

allInclusive.title: All-inclusive
allInclusive.body: A brand-new car with one weekly price. Insurance, servicing, maintenance, tyres, rego, CTP and roadside — everything but fuel.

noCredit.title: Approval that fits your situation
noCredit.body: No Australian credit history? New to the country, or between traditional finance options? We assess your signed contract, income and timeline — not just a credit score.

included.title: One weekly price. Everything but fuel.
included.subtitle: No surprise bills, no separate policies, no rego renewals. If the car needs it, it's covered.
included.fuelExcludedNote: The only thing you pay for is fuel.

delivery.title: Delivery & drop-off
delivery.body: Your car is delivered wherever you're starting — airport, home or site — ready to drive. When your term ends, simply drop the car off with us. We'll make the drop-off easy.
delivery.point1: Airport, home or site delivery, timed to your start
delivery.point2: Fully registered, insured and fuelled for handover
delivery.point3: Easy drop-off with us when your term ends

who.a: Anyone in Australia for a defined term — visa holders, fixed-term contract and project workers, secondments and relocations — who needs a car for exactly the length of their stay or engagement.

included.q: What does the weekly price include?
included.a: Everything except fuel: comprehensive insurance, servicing, maintenance, tyres, registration and CTP, 24/7 roadside assistance, plus delivery and end-of-term drop-off. One payment, no surprises.

credit.q: Do I need an Australian credit history?
credit.a: No. We approve you on your employment contract, salary and visa. You can be approved before you even land in Australia.

term.q: Can the lease really match my exact timeline?
term.a: Yes. Any term from 9 to 36 months — including non-standard terms like 15 months. Set the slider to your end date and that's your lease.

km.a: Pricing is based on up to {km} km per week. If you drive more, excess kilometres are charged at a published per-km rate — you'll always know it up front.

end.q: What happens at the end of my lease?
end.a: You drop the car off with us — we'll make it easy and confirm everything ahead of time. If your visa or contract is extended, you can extend or re-lease instead.

apply.q: Can I apply before I arrive in Australia?
apply.a: Yes — most of our customers do. Apply with your employment contract and visa, get approved, and your car will be waiting when you land.

notVisa.q: I'm not on a visa — can I still lease?
notVisa.a: Yes. OpenLease is for anyone with a defined-term need: fixed-term employment contracts, project or seasonal work, relocations and secondments. Your timeline sets the term.

setTerm.q: How do you set my term?
setTerm.a: You tell us what sets your timeline — your visa expiry, contract end or project finish — and we match the lease term to that date. You can adjust it to any length between 9 and 36 months.

extended.q: What happens if my contract is extended?
extended.a: Tell us the new end date and we'll extend your lease or set up a fresh one to match, subject to approval.

earlyEnd.q: What if my term ends early?
earlyEnd.a: Talk to us as soon as you know. Early-end options and any applicable costs are set out in your lease agreement — we'll walk you through them before you sign. [Final approved wording to come.]

disclaimer.text: All pricing is indicative and based on the driver travelling up to {km} km per week. Excess kilometres are charged at a published per-km rate. Final pricing is confirmed on application and subject to assessment and approval. OpenLease agreements are consumer leases provided under applicable Australian consumer credit law.
